summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a Bible verse from Genesis 6:9, which reads: "These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God." The verse is shown in a highlighted box over a background image of a hand reaching towards the sky.

At the top of the screen, there are navigation and action icons, including a back arrow, a share icon, and an edit icon.

Below the verse, there is a "Share" section with various sharing options. The available sharing methods include:
- Facebook
- Hi
- Sell on Local
- Android Beam
- Bluetooth
- Messaging
- Pleco OCR
- Wickr

The time is displayed at the top right corner of the screen, showing 11:09. The status bar also shows various icons indicating notifications and device status.
